title: Talk at the University of Georgia
summary: I presented a talk on “Describing electronic topology using interacting Green’s function” at the Center for Simulational Physics, University of Georgia.

title: BSE paper published in JCTC
summary: Our work led by Ming Wen combines a self-consistent GW reference with a dynamical screening correction to improve molecular excitation energies.

title: New quantum impurity solver preprint
summary: Our collaboration led by Yang Yu combines Hamiltonian and diagrammatic methods to improve the accuracy and convergence of quantum impurity calculations.

title: Talk at ICQC 2026
summary: I presented our work on correlated topological materials using first-principles self-consistent GW at the International Congress on Quantum Chemistry in Berkeley.

title: Best Poster Award in Warsaw
summary: My poster on describing disorder and correlation with coherent potential approximation and Bloch Gaussian orbitals received the Best Poster Award at New Challenges for Ab-initio Theory in Molecular Sciences.

title: Preprint on topological phases in α-Sn
summary: Our initial preprint explored strain-tunable topological phases in gray tin using fully self-consistent relativistic GW.
